cim: Nobel Prize laureates gather in Stockholm to discuss artificial intelligence
cim_eredeti: Nobel Prize laureates gather in Stockholm to discuss artificial intelligence
szoveg_eredeti:
Artificial intelligence promises to transform science and society, but where will it take us? On 9 December, Nobel Prize laureates and leading thinkers will come together in Stockholm for the Nobel Week Dialogue 2026 to examine the opportunities, risks and choices that come with life in the age of AI.

Today we see AI tools rapidly becoming more powerful. Advocates highlight AI’s potential to serve humanity and the promise that it will contribute to major scientific advances. Some early promise has become reality, but many warn of risks to society, to the future of work, education and democracy.

Why are experts so divided on opportunities and risks? Given this uncertainty, how should we map our path to living with AI, and how can we ensure its benefits are shared to the fullest extent?

The Nobel Week Dialogue takes place on 9 December 2026, from 10:00 to 15:30 at House of People in Stockholm. Speakers include Nobel Prize laureates Philippe Aghion (economic sciences 2025), Steven Chu (physics 1997), John Jumper (chemistry 2024) and David MacMillan (chemistry 2021).

The event is fully booked but media can apply to participate by using this form: Registration press programme Nobel Week 2026 All interview must be booked in advance. Please contact: [email protected]

The Nobel Week Dialogue is held in Stockholm every other year and in Gothenburg (Göteborg) every other year. The Nobel Week Dialogue is organised by Nobel Prize Outreach in collaboration with Carl Bennet AB, the City of Gothenburg, Royalty Pharma and Volvo Group.

This year marks the 125th anniversary of the Nobel Prize. In September, the Nobel Foundation announced that the Nobel Prize amount would increase to SEK 12 million per prize category, an increase of SEK 1 million compared with the previous year.

This year’s Nobel Prize laureates were announced from 5–12 October: https://www.nobelprize.org/all-nobel-prizes-2026/

The press programme for Nobel Week is available here: https://www.nobelprize.org/press-programme-for-nobel-week-2026/

The Nobel Week Dialogue is an annual conference on 9 December in Nobel Week. The goal of the event is to bring together a select group of the world’s leading scientists, policy-makers and thinkers for a series of thought-provoking sessions and working groups on a topical science-related theme. With this event we aim to deepen the dialogue between the scientific community and the rest of society on issues connected with the Nobel Prize and of importance for the world.
